name: CRLF Injection & HTTP Response Splitting Engine
description: High-impact Carriage Return Line Feed (CRLF, \r\n, %0d%0a) injection and HTTP response splitting auditor. Identifies header injection, arbitrary Set-Cookie session fixation, XSS via response body splitting, and proxy cache poisoning across web applications, reverse proxies, and load balancers.
author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

test_header_injection.description: Probe for injected arbitrary response headers (Set-Cookie, X-Injected-Header)

test_encoding_variations.description: Test URL-encoded, double-encoded, and Unicode CRLF sequences (%0d%0a, %250d%250a, %E5%98%8D%E5%98%8A)

test_body_splitting.description: Evaluate susceptibility to complete HTTP response splitting with fake HTML bodies
